changelog:
Update dialog: dismiss now persists to Firestore (survives reinstall)
Update dialog: 'Update Now' also records dismiss (no more infinite loop)
M-Pesa: direct tournament fee payment via STK push when wallet balance insufficient
adminChangelog:
Fix: update dialog dismiss now writes to Firestore users/{userId}/dismissedBuild — survived uninstall/reinstall
Fix: 'Update Now' button also calls markBuildDismissed() before downloading — install cancellation no longer causes infinite dialog loop
Feat: tournament detail screen offers 'Pay with M-Pesa' option when wallet balance insufficient for entry fee
Feat: stkPush Cloud Function parameterized with type (deposit/tournamentFee) and tournamentId
Feat: mpesaCallback handles tournamentFee type — credits super wallet prizePool + platformEarnings, marks participation as paid
